claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 26 component ablation remains valid, but Stage 27A did not establish that the selected component family is sufficient to restore the readout under patching controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: CAS Harness identifies a bounded Pythia-160M attention-head path for the Stage 7 Foundation readout with ablation necessity and patch-restoration sufficiency evidence.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, raw CAS-symbol understanding, internal CAS compiler behavior, free-form generation control, or cross-model component generality from Stage 27A.

component_scope.mlp_blocks: not primary in Stage 27A because Stage 26 selected family is all attention heads
component_scope.patching_unit: full-sequence selected-head slice, not only focus-token slice

primary_components.hook_target: input slices to GPT-NeoX attention.dense before output projection
primary_components.selection_source: Stage 26 matched-control PASS top-six component family

formal_anchor: Noetic coverage / jointly-surjective-family framing: the selected attention-head family is tested as a local covering family for the Stage 7 Foundation readout, not as exact neurons.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest and Stage 26 report is PASS
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: selected-component ablation drops Foundation probe accuracy by at least 0.25 on the evaluated rows
gates.name: ablation_replicates_stage26

gates.criterion: patching clean selected-component slices restores at least 50% of the targeted-ablation lost accuracy
gates.name: patch_restoration

gates.criterion: selected-component patch restoration exceeds matched random patch restoration, empirical p < 0.05
gates.name: matched_patch_control

gates.criterion: restoration is visible in the top disrupted Foundation classes and is not merely a no-op scoring artifact
gates.name: class_restoration

gates.criterion: no-op and baseline repeat predictions match within the preregistered slack
gates.name: sanity_controls

method: Recover the Stage 7 Foundation probe on locked layer-6 focus-token activations.
Load the Stage 26 selected attention-head family from the committed Stage 26 result.
On held-out Stage 7 test rows, run baseline forwards and score the locked Foundation probe.
Run targeted ablation by zeroing the selected head slices before attention.dense.
Run patch restoration by caching clean selected head slices and inserting them into the ablated forward.
Run matched random patch controls by ablating the selected heads while patching same-kind/layer non-selected heads.
Report lost accuracy, recovered accuracy, recovery fraction, matched-control empirical p-values, and per-class restoration.
motivation: Stage 26 established bounded component-level necessity. Stage 27A tests sufficiency by patching the selected clean component path back into an ablated forward pass.
